description: This file defines the interface DataRegistrationBroker for managing logger data registration in the ECU UI module of the RomRaider project. It declares methods for registering, deregistering, and clearing logger data, and extends a status change listener.

classes.name: DataRegistrationBroker
classes.description: An interface that manages registration of logger data for logging purposes, extending status change listening capabilities.

methods.name: registerLoggerDataForLogging
methods.description: Registers a LoggerData instance for logging.

methods.name: deregisterLoggerDataFromLogging
methods.description: Deregisters a LoggerData instance from logging.
